Name: [Repo] Measures must have a format string
Description: Every visible number needs an explicit format. Add formatString to the measure (TMDL) or set it with the Modeling MCP server.

Name: [Repo] Measures must have a description
Description: Describe the business definition of every measure with a /// line above it in TMDL. Copilot and report users rely on it.

Name: [Repo] Measures should be in a display folder
Description: Group measures by subject with displayFolder so the field list stays navigable.

Name: [Repo] Visible tables should have a description
Description: Describe what one row of the table represents (grain).

Name: [Repo] Object names must not start or end with spaces
Description: Leading or trailing spaces break DAX references and report bindings.
Scope: Table, Measure, DataColumn, CalculatedColumn, CalculatedTableColumn, Hierarchy

Name: [Repo] The model must have a marked date table
Description: Time intelligence needs one table with dataCategory Time and a key Date column.
